career_ladder.note: Office Attendants in the Reserve Bank of India belong to Class IV cadre (subordinate staff) responsible for office administration, document logistics, and operational maintenance across RBI Central Office and Regional Offices nationwide. Employees can advance through structured internal promotional examinations into Class III (clerical cadre) and subsequently into Class I (officer cadre).

exam_scheme.note: Selection for Office Attendant in Reserve Bank of India is conducted in two successive stages: an Online Objective Examination (120 marks, 90 minutes) followed by a Language Proficiency Test (LPT) in the official/local language of the state concerned. The LPT is mandatory and qualifying in nature; final selection is based strictly on the merit score secured in the online examination.

financial_package.note: Office Attendants receive basic pay starting at ₹24,250 per month under the revised RBI Class IV wage settlement (earlier starting basic pay ₹10,940 in scale ₹10940-380(4)-12460-440(3)-13780-520(3)-15340-690(2)-16720-740(4)-19680-840(3)-22200-1120(1)-23700). Initial monthly gross emoluments are approximately ₹42,000 to ₹46,000 per month.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Reserve Bank of India — Recruitment of Office Attendants Notification (Salary & Emoluments)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on revised entry basic pay of ₹24,250 plus applicable Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance (15% if Bank quarters not allotted), Special Allowance, Grade Allowance, and Local Compensatory Allowance; net salary factors in standard pension and provident fund contributions.
official_perks: Bank accommodation (subject to availability) or 15% House Rent Allowance
Comprehensive medical dispensary facilities and hospitalization reimbursement
Defined contribution pension scheme under Reserve Bank of India Pension Regulations
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and festival advance provisions
Subsidized canteen facilities, book grant, and washing allowance

competition_benchmarks.note: Recruitment for Office Attendants in RBI is conducted periodically across 17 regional office zones. In the 2021 pan-India recruitment, a total of 841 vacancies were notified across regional offices.
